uiMeta.shareTitle: Evaluating the best Prime Minister of India is subjective.

metric.name: Subjectivity of Evaluation
metric.description: The evaluation of Prime Ministers varies based on personal opinions.

insight: Determining the best Prime Minister of India is inherently subjective, influenced by personal opinions and political beliefs. It's like trying to pick the best flavor of ice cream—everyone has their favorite, but there's no definitive answer.
title: Evaluating the best Prime Minister of India is subjective.
